sql: SELECT sc.School, sc.DOC FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS f2 INNER JOIN schools AS sc2 ON f2.CDSCode = sc2.CDSCode WHERE sc2.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

SELECT sc.AdmFName1, sc.AdmLName1, sc.AdmFName2, sc.AdmLName2, sc.AdmFName3, sc.AdmLName3 FROM satscores AS s INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.County = 'Los Angeles' AND sc.Charter = 0 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT sc.City, COUNT(*) FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.Magnet = 1 AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '8' AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY sc.City

SELECT sc.AdmEmail1, sc.AdmEmail2 FROM schools AS sc WHERE sc.County = 'San Bernardino' AND sc.City = 'San Bernardino' AND sc.DOC = '54' AND sc.SOC = '62' AND sc.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
SELECT sc.School, sc.Street FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
SELECT s.sname, f.`Charter Funding Type` FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE f.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' AND s.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT f.`School Name`, sc.Street, sc.City, sc.State, sc.Zip FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.County = 'Monterey' AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
SELECT sc.School, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.Phone FROM schools AS sc LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE sc.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR sc.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm AS f ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools AS sc INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400 AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS sc INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
